title: Vocabulary Quiz — Unit 10C: Asking for help and online posts
subtitle: Technology, instructions, texts and discussion boards

words.def: to do something for someone so that things are easier
words.sent: Could you ___ me with my tablet?

words.def: to say something so that someone understands it
words.sent: Would you mind ___ this word to me?

words.def: words that tell you how to do something
words.sent: Read the ___ before you use the machine.

words.def: a flat computer with a big touch screen
words.sent: Annie can’t get into her email on her ___.

words.def: the flat part of a phone or computer where you see things
words.sent: A new ___ opens when you touch the button.

words.def: a small part that you press to make a machine work
words.sent: Touch this ___ here and wait.

words.def: a small device you move to control a computer
words.sent: My new ___ isn’t working. Can you help me?

words.def: an event when people come together to talk about work
words.sent: Dan can’t come to lunch. He’s in a ___.

words.def: something difficult that you need to solve
words.sent: I have a ___ with my phone. It doesn’t work.

words.def: a short piece of writing that you send to someone
words.sent: I got a text ___ from my sister.

words.def: something that you write online for other people to read
words.sent: I read her ___ about phones on the discussion board.

words.def: making you a little angry
words.sent: It’s very ___ when people look at their phones at dinner.

words.def: not polite
words.sent: It’s ___ not to look at someone when they’re talking.

words.def: to have the same opinion as someone
words.sent: I ___ with you. It’s really annoying.

words.def: to have a different opinion
words.sent: I ___ with Genji. I don’t mind phones at dinner.

words.def: to make a noise when something is funny
words.sent: My friends send funny texts, so we ___ a lot.

words.def: a picture that you take with a camera or a phone
words.sent: He took a ___ of his meal in Italy.

words.def: a talk between two or more people
words.sent: They had a long ___ about the film.

words.def: to go from one place to another, often a long way
words.sent: I send texts to my family when I ___ for work.

words.def: to like one thing more than another
words.sent: I ___ to talk on the phone. It’s friendlier.
